registration_boundary: Historical exploration and Development36 B0/A summary observed; C/BC historical audit ongoing; Internal30 and new Final unopened. Applies to one Development-selected challenger, frozen before Internal, with no test-driven selection or tuning.
unit: physical parent; paired frame values -> episode means -> parent means; R/D branches of a parent are not independent
reference: EXACT_GT only; unsupported frames excluded and counted; no approximate reference upgrade

primary.name: graph_relevant_correct_mask_availability
primary.per_slot_frame: GT visible pixels>=8; success iff prediction nonempty, pixel precision>=0.9 and IoU>=0.5; empty prediction is failed availability, with its precision still undefined
primary.aggregation: mean within eligible frames of each episode/slot, mean episodes within parent/slot, equal-weight available slots within parent; pair only the same eligible observations; no Wrist Box
primary.zero_baseline_error: no primary headroom; cannot establish improvement on this stratum

downstream.name: correct_source_3d_coverage
downstream.definition: fraction of current GT actor surface samples with finite depth supported within radius by a selected point whose actual current source pixel belongs to that actor; Peg Main+Wrist, Box Main only
downstream.aggregation: paired episode/parent means per object, then equal-weight available Peg and Box per parent

safety.visible_wrong_mask_definition: prediction nonempty and precision<0.8 among GT visible>=8; a separate event metric, never an imputed precision
safety.healthy_tracking_damage_definition: on exact GT-visible slot-frames where B0 satisfies correct-mask availability, candidate loses that availability; paired episode/parent rate, never used as an inference trigger
safety.undefined_precision: reported separately by condition with actual counts; pooled-pixel precision and FP event metrics must also be shown
safety.undefined_or_no_support_stratum: cannot claim safety verified; report INCONCLUSIVE for that constraint

runtime.measurement: observer-free live B0 and challenger, separate model/memory resets, same hardware/runtime/input ordering; synchronize CUDA; include actual detector, feature, SAM, correction, geometry and Graph; no shared cross-condition inference cache credit
runtime.20Hz: cannot claim 20Hz closed-loop; measured per-frame <=50ms alone does not validate policy/simulator scheduling

evaluation_order: Select at most one challenger using Development only; freeze source/config/criteria hash before Internal30
Internal30 once; source/config cannot be tuned in response and retain independent-test status
Freeze final source/config and permitted scope before new normal/stress capture and performance evaluation
Final normal and stress metrics reported separately; no Final-driven retuning or same-Final rerun as new test

decision.GO: Primary and downstream gains plus safety/runtime constraints verified on untouched final normal and stress strata; only offline perception/cache handoff, no production replacement authorization
decision.CONDITIONAL_GO: Same benefit/safety requirements verified for a narrower scope explicitly registered before opening Final; no overall pipeline GO
decision.TRADEOFF_UNRESOLVED: Verified benefit accompanied by a material safety/surface/runtime deterioration; no Stage4B full recache authorization
decision.NO_GO: No verified practical benefit or a clear safety violation; no Stage4B full recache authorization
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: Exact reference, effective parent sample or necessary support missing so evaluation cannot establish the registered result; no Stage4B full recache authorization

sample_review.claim: Operational minimum only; paired parent uncertainty determines evidence. Rare t0 failure reduction is secondary because baseline headroom may be zero or too small.
sample_review.normal_approx_80pct_power_effect_for_n32: (1.96+0.84)*paired_parent_SD/sqrt(32); SD estimated on Development, not Final
sample_review.precision_or_rare_failure_limit: Zero observed errors among32 parents cannot demonstrate a population error probability below1%; do not equate operational sample size with sufficiency
